outcome: Concentrations of specific HMOs (2'-FL, LNnT, LSTc, LNFP-I, DSLNT, DFpLNnH, DFLNH[a], 3'-SL, 3-FL)
cohort: 481 mothers from a larger cross-sectional study in China (n=6481)
finding: HMO concentration in breast milk decreases throughout lactation and is influenced by lactation stage, maternal secretor gene status, Lewis blood type, volume of breast milk expressed, and province of residence.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery did not significantly affect HMO concentration.
